(1) The scheduled-automation path resolves branding from the WORKFLOW's owner rather than the booked event: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 calls getHideBranding({userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId}), and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same from form.userId/form.teamId, so a personal workflow attached to a team/org event resolves against the user row. (2) Every booking-side caller that feeds scheduleWorkflowReminders passes the raw per-user column instead of the resolver: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618,2793,2808 (`!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding`), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459,472 (selects only owner.hideBranding at :311 and :361), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:31,112, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:561, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671 (and a hardcoded hideBranding: true at :604), packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188. For a team event eventType.owner is null, so the flag collapses to false and the vendor footer is emitted.
